cards.title: Play School Returns: TV Worth Watching With Your Toddler
cards.body: This beloved children's program offers a refreshing alternative to overstimulating shows designed to grab attention like smartphones do. Parents can finally feel good about screen time their young children are consuming.

cards.title: Sleepover Safety: The Secret Codeword Strategy
cards.body: Establish a discreet codeword your child can use to signal distress at sleepovers without alerting everyone around them. This simple tool helps anxious kids communicate they need to come home.

cards.title: Working Parents Face Logistical Nightmare With School Hours
cards.body: The school day ending at 3pm creates a real scheduling crisis when work continues until 5pm or later. Many parents struggle with the gap between school schedules and workplace expectations.

cards.title: Modern Family Pressures: Cost of Living and Childcare Gaps
cards.body: Australian working parents face compounding pressures including soaring costs, rigid workplace demands, and insufficient childcare coverage. The current system leaves families struggling to manage basic logistics.

cards.title: Why Kids Lie, Steal, and Curse: What Parents Should Know
cards.body: Understanding the underlying causes of misbehavior helps parents address fundamental issues rather than just punishing bad actions. When parents recognize what's driving acting out, they can respond more effectively.

cards.title: Three Ways Parents Accidentally Wreck Their Child's Confidence
cards.body: Constant help and intervention can teach children they're incapable of handling challenges without parental support. This well-intentioned approach may undermine their developing independence and self-reliance.

cards.title: Postpartum Depression Often Begins Before Birth
cards.body: A large study of new mothers reveals mental health symptoms frequently start during pregnancy, not after delivery. Depression is only part of a broader spectrum of perinatal mental health challenges.

cards.title: Anxious Bedtime Battles: Getting Your Child to Sleep Alone
cards.body: If your child has tantrums about sleeping alone or in their own room, you're not alone in this struggle. Learn what sleep experts recommend for managing bedtime anxiety.

cards.title: Parents Must Share Domestic Load to Prevent Burnout
cards.body: When one partner carries the mental load of home and family care, burnout and relationship breakdown loom large. More balanced distribution of household duties protects both partnership and parental wellbeing.

cards.title: Government Moves to Stop Airline Seat Charges for Children
cards.body: Airlines currently charge up to £104 for parents and children to sit together on return journeys. The government is pushing to end this practice and keep families together on flights.
